title: VectorChunk.v0
description: A vector embedding of a content chunk, bound to its source FAIR_OBJECT via the 'indexed_as' edge and carrying its memory-scope envelope. Resolves GAP-ER-1: memoryd stores embeddings without a first-class contract binding chunk → FAIR_OBJECT + scope.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier for this vector chunk. Recommended format: vc-<hex12>.

object_id.description: FAIR_OBJECT.object_id this chunk is indexed from. Declares the 'FAIR_OBJECT indexed_as VECTOR_CHUNK' edge defined in metadata-standards.

embedding_ref.description: Reference to the embedding artifact — EmbeddingComputed.event_id or a governed artifact URI. Points to the vector coordinates and model provenance.

scope.description: Memory-scope envelope: which topic set, domain, and optional span this chunk covers.

topic_set.description: Topics or concept handles this chunk relates to (e.g. ['medical.cardiology', 'patient.rx']).

span.description: Optional character-offset or token span within the source object.

indexed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this chunk was indexed into the vector store.

vector_dim.description: Dimensionality of the embedding vector (must match the collection configuration).

collection_ref.description: Optional: the Qdrant (or equivalent) collection name where this point lives.

non_claims: This contract does not carry vector coordinates — those live in embedding_ref.
This contract does not execute memory queries or writes.
This contract does not define the FAIR_OBJECT schema — see metadata-standards.
This contract does not assert that the object_id has been verified or admitted.
